priorityList: Maintain Shield Block at all times, ensuring the remaining duration stays above 10 seconds.
Use Ignore Pain to spend excess Rage (above 70) or to prevent capping before high-generator abilities like Shield Slam.
Cast Avatar if you have 2 or fewer stacks of Thunder Blast.
Cast Demoralizing Shout on cooldown if Booming Voice is talented for the damage and Rage buff.
Cast Ravager and Champion's Spear on cooldown for high AoE damage and Rage generation.
Use Shield Charge on cooldown for damage and to close gaps.
Use Thunder Blast or Thunder Clap immediately if Rend is not active on your targets.
Prioritize Thunder Blast when you have 2 stacks and at least 2 targets are present.
In AoE, prioritize Thunder Blast whenever Avatar is active.
Use Execute on 2+ targets if you have a Sudden Death proc or high Rage (with Heavy Handed talent).
Cast Thunder Clap while Avatar is active when facing 4 or more targets.
Use Shield Slam if Rage is below 60 or if Violent Outburst is active.
Use Thunder Blast as your primary rotational filler whenever available.
Use Thunder Clap as your secondary rotational filler to fill gaps.
Use Revenge to dump excess Rage (above 70 in AoE) or if it is free from procs.
